sentences.en: LEON: Hi Shannon - how are you settling into your new flat?
sentences.zh: LEON: 嗨，香农——你新公寓住得还习惯吗？

sentences.en: SHANNON: Really well, thanks.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 非常好，谢谢。

sentences.en: LEON: You look like you're going shopping.
sentences.zh: LEON: 你看起来像是要去购物。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 是的，我正要去。

sentences.en: My cousins are coming to stay for a couple of days, and I have to cook for them.
sentences.zh: 我表兄妹要来住几天，我得给他们做饭。

sentences.en: LEON: Well. there are plenty of places to buy food in Kite Place it's the area by the harbour.
sentences.zh: LEON: 呃，基特广场（Kite Place）有很多买食物的地方，那是在港口附近。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Oh, OK, I'll find that on the map.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 哦，好的，我查一下地图找找那里。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: LEON: What sort of food do you need to get?
sentences.zh: LEON: 你需要买些什么食物？

sentences.en: SHANNON: Well, neither of them eats meat but they both like fish.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 呃，他们俩都不吃肉，但都喜欢鱼。

sentences.en: LEON: a Well, there's a really good fish market there.
sentences.zh: LEON: 呃，那儿有一家非常棒的鱼市。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Oh great - where is it exactly?
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 哦，太好了——它具体在哪儿？

sentences.en: LEON: It's at the far end of Kite Place, so you have to go over the bridge and then it's on the right.
sentences.zh: LEON: 它在基特广场最远的一端，所以你得先过桥，然后它就在你的右手边。

sentences.en: SHANNON: OK - is open all day?
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 好的——它全天都营业吗？

sentences.en: LEON: It doesn't close until four, but I'd recommend going earlier than that - it does run out of some things.
sentences.zh: LEON: 它直到下午四点才关门，但我建议你早点去——有些东西会卖完。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Oh, I don't want that to happen.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 哦，我不想碰到那种情况。

sentences.en: LEON: As long as you get there by 3.30, you should be fine.
sentences.zh: LEON: 只要你在3:30之前到那儿，应该就没事了。

sentences.en: It's only 11 now, so plenty of time.
sentences.zh: 现在才11点，时间很充裕。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Right.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 好的。

sentences.en: LEON: Do you need to buy vegetables too?
sentences.zh: LEON: 你还需要买蔬菜吗？

sentences.en: SHANNON: I do, and I want to avoid all the plastic packaging in the supermarket!
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 我需要，而且我想避开超市里所有塑料包装！

sentences.en: LEON: Well, there's a really nice organic shop there.
sentences.zh: LEON: 呃，那儿有一家很棒的有机食品店。

sentences.en: Now what's it called . it's the name of a flower. know, it's 'Rose'.
sentences.zh: 现在它叫什么来着……是一家花的名字。对，是‘玫瑰’（Rose）。

sentences.en: SHANNON: That's a nice name.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 这名字真不错。

sentences.en: LEON: Yeah - it sells vegetables and quite a lot of other stuff.
sentences.zh: LEON: 是啊——它卖蔬菜，还有不少其他商品。

sentences.en: SHANNON: And where's that?
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 那它在哪儿？

sentences.en: LEON: Well, as you reach the market, you'll see a big grey building on your left - I think it used to be a warehouse.
sentences.zh: LEON: 呃，当你走到鱼市时，会在左手边看到一栋很大的灰色建筑——我想它以前是个仓库。

sentences.en: Anyway, now it's a restaurant upstairs, but the ground floor has two shops either side of the entrance and t's the one on the left.
sentences.zh: 总之，现在楼上是一家餐厅，但一楼入口两侧各有一家商店，它在左边那家。

sentences.en: SHANNON: That's easy enough.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 这还挺容易找的。

sentences.en: LEON: You can't miss it - there's also a big sign on the pavement so you can look for that.
sentences.zh: LEON: 你不会错过的——人行道上还有一块很大的招牌，你可以留意找找。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Fine!
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 好的！

sentences.en: I guess if I need anything else, I'll have to go to the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我想如果还需要别的东西，我就得去超市了。

sentences.en: LEON: Yeah you should be able to get everything you need, but there's a minibus that goes to the supermarket if you need it.
sentences.zh: LEON: 是的，你应该能买到所有需要的东西，不过如果需要的话，还有辆迷你巴士可以去超市。

sentences.en: It's purple and the number is 289.
sentences.zh: 车是紫色的，车号是289。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Thanks, that's great.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 谢谢，这太好了。

sentences.en: LEON: So what do you need to get at the fish market?
sentences.zh: LEON: 那你在鱼市需要买些什么？

sentences.en: The salmon is always very good and the shellfish.
sentences.zh: 三文鱼一向很好，贝类也不错。

sentences.en: SHANNON: to I'm going to make a curry, I think, a and need about 12 prawns for that.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 我想做咖喱，大概需要12只虾。

sentences.en: LEON: They'll have plenty of those.
sentences.zh: LEON: 那儿肯定有充足的供应。

sentences.en: SHANNON: OK.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 好的。

sentences.en: LEON: Have you ever tried samphire?
sentences.zh: LEON: 你尝过海蓬子吗？

sentences.en: SHANNON: No - what's that?
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 没有——那是什么？

sentences.en: LEON: It's a type of seaweed.
sentences.zh: LEON: 它是一种海藻。

sentences.en: I just ask for a handful and you fry it in butter.
sentences.zh: 我只要一小把，然后用黄油煎一下。

sentences.en: It's delicious!
sentences.zh: 非常美味！

sentences.en: SHANNON: Oh, I might try that - how do you spell it?
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 哦，我或许可以试试——怎么拼写？

sentences.en: LEON: It's S-A-M-P-H-I-R-E.
sentences.zh: LEON: 是 S-A-M-P-H-I-R-E。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Great - it's always good to try something different.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 太好了——尝试些新东西总是不错的。

sentences.en: LEON: Yeah.
sentences.zh: LEON: 是啊。

sentences.en: SHANNON: I'll see what beans they have in the organic shop and think I'll get something for dessert there.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 我去看看有机食品店有什么豆类，再想想在那儿买点什么当甜点。

sentences.en: LEON: How about a mango? a
sentences.zh: LEON: 芒果怎么样？

sentences.en: SHANNON: I'm not sure - they're not always ripe.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 我不太确定——它们并不总是熟的。

sentences.en: I'd prefer a melon - it's bigger too.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢哈密瓜——它个头也更大。

sentences.en: LEON: Good idea.
sentences.zh: LEON: 好主意。

sentences.en: The owner also sells a lot a of spices there that you can put in a curry, and things like coconut.
sentences.zh: 店主还在那儿卖很多香料，可以用来做咖喱，还有椰子之类的东西。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Oh, that's very helpful.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 哦，这非常有用。

sentences.en: I'll have a look.
sentences.zh: 我会去看看。

sentences.en: LEON: No problem.
sentences.zh: LEON: 没问题。

sentences.en: SHANNON: I know bread doesn't really go with curry but I always like to have some in case.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 我知道面包其实不太配咖喱，但我总想备一些以防万一。

sentences.en: LEON: As I said - all the bread is home-made and there's lots of variety. like the brown bread myself.
sentences.zh: LEON: 正如我之前所说——所有面包都是自制的，种类也非常丰富。我个人很喜欢那种全麦面包。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Mm, sounds good.
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 嗯，听起来不错。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: LEON: They sell other things there too.
sentences.zh: LEON: 那儿还卖其他东西。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Like cakes?
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 比如蛋糕？

sentences.en: I love chocolate cake.
sentences.zh: 我最爱巧克力蛋糕。

sentences.en: LEON: Well - not that, but they have a whole range of tarts and the best are the strawberry ones.
sentences.zh: LEON: 嗯——这个倒没有，但他们有一整套挞类点心，其中最好吃的是草莓挞。

sentences.en: SHANNON: Perfect - hopefully I won't even have to go to the supermarket!
sentences.zh: SHANNON: 太完美了——希望我甚至都不用去超市了！
